Overview.Name: Manasa Adepu
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction, Support better PCOS and blood pressure management.
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Early_Morning (optional): Option 3: Any 1 fruit (apple, guava, orange or papaya)
Meal_1: Option 2: Paneer cubes (100 g) + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (small bowl ~150 g) + curd (small bowl)

Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) + paneer curry (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + egg curry (2 eggs) + vegetable curry
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + paneer cubes (80 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) + chicken curry (100 g) + cucumber salad

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid skipping meals, especially on busy workdays or late nights.
Choose homemade foods and reduce packaged, salty and fried foods to help support healthy blood pressure.
When sweet cravings occur, have a fruit first and wait 10 minutes before choosing another snack.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Practice yoga regularly and include a 30-minute walk on most days to support weight loss, PCOS management and overall health.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily and aim for consistent meal and sleep timings.
